implementationScope: Export predicate isMagazineAmmo(value: unknown): value is MagazineAmmo validating non-negative safe integers
Export assertion assertMagazineAmmo(value: unknown, context?: string): asserts value is MagazineAmmo throwing TypeError on invalid input
Export interface MagazineAmmoState { readonly current: MagazineAmmo; } representing the current ammunition count for a magazine
Export factory createMagazineAmmoState(current: MagazineAmmo): MagazineAmmoState requiring explicit caller-supplied current value without defaults
Enforce Object.freeze immutability on returned MagazineAmmoState instances
Document that negative-value rejection is a Human-approved API/data-safety precondition, not canonical gameplay semantics
Headless Vitest unit tests in tests/game-domain.test.ts

clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is FALSE (zero semantic files modified).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).
MagazineAmmoState represents only the current ammunition count for a magazine without ownership decomposition between character and weapon.

createMagazineAmmoState requires explicit caller argument; no default 0 or full.
